methods.comment: * Return the kth(0-based) smallest element from the given unsorted list. * * @param list The input list, it will be modified by the algorithm here. * @param start The start offset of the list, inclusive. * @param length The length of the sub list to be searched in. * @param k The 0-based index. * @param comparator The comparator which knows how to compare the elements in the list. * @return The kth smallest element from the given list, * or IllegalArgumentException will be thrown if not found.
